items.title: Canadian Start-up smartARM Uses AI to Create Intuitive Bionic Prosthetics
items.summary: People and companies are using AI hardware and software to make life easier and more accessible for everyone. That’s the case with smartARM, a Toronto-based startup developing a vision-first bionic arm prototype that uses open-source software, with Meta AI glasses as an optional add-on, to explore more intuitive prosthetic control for people living with limb differences. https://about.fb.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/0

items.title: Memory in Grok Build
